adopt: Point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, score one model on items that each have an exact oracle, and compare it with a second run only when both scored the same items.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
General benchmarks measure what a model knows. An agent stack needs to know whether it calibrates effort, orders a plan by dependency, declines instead of confabulating and says "could not check" instead of "fine" -- and a judge model cannot settle that, because a judge is a model. Two scores are comparable only when they came from the same items: a count match proves nothing, since swapping an item keeps the count.

Install
pip install awbench

Commands
  awbench

Quick start
  awbench run --model my-model --url http://localhost:8000 --json run.json
  awbench compare baseline.json run.json

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awbench/
synopsis: A hard-oracle benchmark for a served model -- no LLM judge, and no comparison across different item sets.
